a20-s4.plain: The Legislature may not pass laws permitting the leasing or alienation of a franchise so as to relieve the franchise or property held under it from liabilities incurred in operating, using, or enjoying the franchise or its privileges.
limits: The Legislature shall not pass any laws permitting the leasing or alienation of any franchise

a20-s5.title: Corporation laws may be changed
a20-s5.plain: All laws in force concerning corporations, and all laws later passed under this section, may be altered from time to time or repealed.
powers: may be altered from time to time or repealed

a20-s6.title: Benefits for legislators with shortened terms
a20-s6.plain: A legislator whose term was reduced by the 1972 amendment to subdivision (a) of Section 2 of Article IV is entitled to retirement benefits and compensation as if the term had not been reduced.
rights: be entitled to retirement benefits and compensation as if the term of office had not been so reduced

a20-s7.title: When term limits apply
a20-s7.plain: The term limits in Articles IV, V, IX, and XIII apply only to terms beginning by election or appointment on or after November 6, 1990, with an extra term for certain incumbent Senators. They do not apply to an unexpired term of less than half a full term.
limits: Those limitations shall not apply to any unexpired term

a20-s22.title: Alcoholic beverage control
a20-s22.plain: The State has the exclusive right and power to license and regulate alcoholic beverages. The section sets up licensing, bars sales to and purchases by persons under 21, creates the Director and Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control and an Appeals Board, and sets their powers.
powers: shall have the exclusive right and power to license and regulate the manufacture, sale, purchase, possession and transportation of alcoholic beverages
shall have the exclusive right and power to regulate the importation into and exportation from the State, of alcoholic beverages
the Legislature may provide for the issuance of, among other licenses, licenses for the following types of premises
shall be appointed by the Governor
The director may be removed from office by the Governor
the Legislature shall have the power, by a majority vote of all members elected to each house, to remove the director from office
The director may appoint three persons who shall be exempt from civil service
shall have the exclusive power, except as herein provided and in accordance with laws enacted by the Legislature, to license the manufacture, importation and sale of alcoholic beverages in this State
shall have the power, in its discretion, to deny, suspend or revoke any specific alcoholic beverages license
The members of the board may be removed from office by the Governor
the Legislature shall have the power, by a majority vote of all members elected to each house, to remove any member from office
it may enter an order remanding the matter to the department for reconsideration
the board may direct the reconsideration of the matter in the light of its order
The Legislature may authorize, subject to reasonable restrictions, the sale in retail stores of alcoholic beverages contained in the original packages
may provide for the issuance of all types of licenses necessary to carry on the activities referred to in the first paragraph of this section
limits: the Legislature shall not constitute the State or any agency thereof a manufacturer or seller of alcoholic beverages
No person under the age of 21 years shall be permitted to enter and remain in any such premises without lawful business therein
no person shall sell, furnish, give, or cause to be sold, furnished, or given away any alcoholic beverage to any person under the age of 21 years
no person under the age of 21 years shall purchase any alcoholic beverage
the board shall not receive evidence in addition to that considered by the department
the order shall not limit or control in any way the discretion vested by law in the department
It shall be unlawful for any person other than a licensee of said department to manufacture, import or sell alcoholic beverages in this State

a20-s23.title: Speaker on the State College governing agency
a20-s23.plain: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Constitution, the Speaker of the Assembly is an ex officio member, with equal rights and duties, of any state agency created by the Legislature to manage and control the State College System of California.

a21-s1.title: Redistricting after each census
a21-s1.plain: In the year after each national census, the Citizens Redistricting Commission must adjust the boundary lines of congressional, State Senate, Assembly, and Board of Equalization districts, following the standards and process in Section 2.

a21-s2.title: Citizens Redistricting Commission and district criteria
a21-s2.plain: Sets up the 14-member Citizens Redistricting Commission, its membership, voting and ethics rules, and the ranked criteria for drawing districts. The commission approves and certifies four final maps, subject to referendum; if a map fails, the Supreme Court has special masters draw it.
limits: The place of residence of any incumbent or political candidate shall not be considered in the creation of a map
Districts shall not be drawn for the purpose of favoring or discriminating against an incumbent, political candidate, or political party
Communities of interest shall not include relationships with political parties, incumbents, or political candidates

a21-s3.title: Defending and challenging redistricting maps
a21-s3.plain: The commission alone may defend a certified final map, and the Legislature must fund that defense. The California Supreme Court has original and exclusive jurisdiction over challenges, and any registered voter may petition for a writ within 45 days of certification.
rights: Any registered voter in this state may file a petition for a writ of mandate or writ of prohibition
Any registered voter in this state may also file a petition for a writ of mandate or writ of prohibition to seek relief
powers: The commission has the sole legal standing to defend any action regarding a certified final map
The commission has sole authority to determine whether the Attorney General or other legal counsel retained by the commission shall assist
The California Supreme Court has original and exclusive jurisdiction

a21-s4.title: Temporary 2025 congressional districts
a21-s4.plain: States California's policy supporting independent redistricting commissions nationwide. In response to Texas's 2025 redistricting, congressional districts in Assembly Bill 604 are used temporarily until the Citizens Redistricting Commission certifies new lines; the commission resumes in 2031.
powers: The Attorney General has the sole legal standing to defend any action regarding a congressional district map
The California Supreme Court has original and exclusive jurisdiction

a22-s1.title: Contracting for architectural and engineering services
a22-s1.plain: The State and all other governmental entities may contract with qualified private entities for architectural and engineering services for all public works, in all phases of project development, without regard to funding source.
powers: shall be allowed to contract with qualified private entities for architectural and engineering services

a22-s2.title: Article VII does not bar private contracting
a22-s2.plain: Nothing in Article VII may be construed to limit, restrict or prohibit the State or other governmental entities from contracting with private entities for architectural and engineering services.
powers: contracting with private entities for the performance of architectural and engineering services

a34-s1.title: Voter approval of low rent housing projects
a34-s1.plain: No state public body may develop, construct or acquire a low rent housing project until a majority of the qualified electors of the city, town or county voting on it approve it at an election. Defines "low rent housing project", "persons of low income", "state public body" and "Federal Government".
limits: No low rent housing project shall hereafter be developed, constructed, or acquired in any manner by any state public body

a34-s2.title: Article XXXIV is self-executing
a34-s2.plain: The provisions of Article XXXIV are self-executing, but legislation not in conflict with it may be enacted to help it operate.
powers: legislation not in conflict herewith may be enacted to facilitate its operation

a34-s3.title: Severability of Article XXXIV
a34-s3.plain: If any part of Article XXXIV, or its application to any person or circumstance, is declared unconstitutional or held invalid, the rest of the Article and its other applications are not affected.

a34-s4.title: Article XXXIV supersedes conflicting provisions
a34-s4.plain: Article XXXIV supersedes all provisions of the Constitution, and laws enacted under it, that conflict with it.

a35-s1.title: California Institute for Regenerative Medicine
a35-s1.plain: Establishes the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine.

a35-s2.title: Purposes of the stem cell institute
a35-s2.plain: The institute's purposes are to make grants and loans for stem cell and other vital research and facilities, to support all stages of developing cures through clinical trials, and to establish regulatory standards and oversight bodies.
powers: To make grants and loans for stem cell research, for research facilities, and for other vital research opportunities
To support all stages of the process of developing cures
To establish the appropriate regulatory standards and oversight bodies for research and facilities development

a35-s3.title: No funds for human reproductive cloning
a35-s3.plain: No funds authorized for, or made available to, the institute may be used for research involving human reproductive cloning.
limits: No funds authorized for, or made available to, the institute shall be used for research involving human reproductive cloning

a35-s4.title: Institute funds continuously appropriated
a35-s4.plain: Funds for the institute are continuously appropriated without regard to fiscal year, may be used only for this article's purposes, and are not subject to appropriation or transfer by the Legislature or the Governor for any other purpose.
limits: shall not be subject to appropriation or transfer by the Legislature or the Governor for any other purpose

a35-s5.title: Right to conduct stem cell research
a35-s5.plain: Establishes a right to conduct stem cell research, including research involving adult, cord blood and pluripotent stem cells and progenitor cells, and defines pluripotent stem cells and progenitor cells.
rights: a right to conduct stem cell research

a35-s6.title: Bond funding for the institute
a35-s6.plain: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Constitution or any law, the institute, established in state government, may use state issued tax-exempt and taxable bonds to fund its operations, research and facilities.
powers: may utilize state issued tax-exempt and taxable bonds

a35-s7.title: Institute exempt from civil service
a35-s7.plain: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Constitution, including Article VII, or any law, the institute and its employees are exempt from civil service.
